concerns.text: Inherited requirements FR-002 and FR-004 (Web Interface for tasks and logging) are unreachable. The tasks implement a data simulation (T003) instead of the required system interfaces, making the actual administration of the study impossible via this plan.

Inherited requirement FR-009 (Pilot check for response times 100ms-5000ms) is unreachable. T003 implements a deterministic simulation, which cannot validate human-interface latency or real-world response ranges.

Task T002 is not self-contained. It requires implementing scoring logic 'based on OSF v2.1+ reference implementations,' but these references are not provided in the inputs, nor is there a task to acquire them.
Task T003 is too coarse. It combines study simulation, checksum generation, and smoke result production into a single task. This should be atomized.
Task T006 is too coarse. It bundles four distinct statistical operations (Bootstrapping, Shapiro-Wilk/Wilcoxon fallback, Cohen's d, and Holm-Bonferroni correction) into one task.
